messages:
Asha (Partnerships): Quick heads-up 1: we need a dry-run schedule for the Partner Hub on Thurs. Goal: full run (intro, 3 partner demos, Q&A, integrator office hours) with MC transitions and one-minute handoffs. Can people confirm availability?
Maya (Marketing): I can do the dry-run at 14:00. Will bring updated partner bios + 1-slide fallbacks. Also suggest we record audio-only backup for the MC in case mics fail.
Tom (Partner PM): Noted. I'll coordinate with AcmeCloud + EdgeHub for demo lead names and fallback screenshots. Also: partners requested a short privacy blurb before the demo (data handling). Any legal copy we should use?
Asha (Partnerships): I'll paste standard privacy blurb in the runbook doc. Keep it 1 sentence.
Sam (Events): AV checklist: ethernet for demo rigs (2x), HDMI split for overflow screens, 2x handhelds + 1x lapel, backup laptop with HDMI. @Logistics Bot can you confirm cables/adapters staged?
Logistics Bot: Staging inventory: ethernet cables x6, HDMI splitters x2, HDMI cables x8, USB-C adapters x6, wireless mics x3, lapel mics x2. Backup laptop: Dell XPS queued. Swag pallet TRK-99877 inbound Fri 07:30.
Diego (Eng): Demo order proposal to reduce hot-starts: 1) lightweight marketplace search (stateless), 2) on-device quantized inference (pre-warmed container), 3) Dedicated multi-tenant load test (longer warmup). If we must swap, we should avoid putting the heavy Dedicated demo first.
Maya (Marketing): Good sequence. Also recommend a 60s pre-recorded clip for the on-device demo in case of connectivity issues. I'll host the clip in the partner drive.
Tom (Partner PM): Can we set an API fallback plan? If Dedicated can't serve, fall back to hosted API in same region + throttle to 20rps. Diego, can you create a short curl snippet partners can use?
Diego (Eng): Yep. Putting snippet here for partners: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite-quant","prompt":"<your prompt>","max_tokens":128}'
```
Asha (Partnerships): Perfect. Add that to the partner runbook. Also: volunteer schedule for swag desk 10:00-12:00, 12:00-14:00, 14:00-16:00. Need 2 volunteers per shift. Maya, can your crew cover the first shift?
Maya (Marketing): Yes to 10:00-12:00. I'll book two folks.
Sam (Events): I'll recruit 2 from Sales for 14:00-16:00. Also volunteer brief will include: 1) one-sentence pitch, 2) QR flow for swag claim, 3) tee limits. Draft brief: - 90s pitch - Demo fallback steps - QR + redemption link - Tee: 1 per attendee. Link: https://docs.redwood/summit/volunteer-brief
Tom (Partner PM): Partners asked about a 30-min integrator lab after the main session for SIs. We have a breakout room free at 16:30. Shall we offer 2 slots (max 10 ppl each) and RSVP?
Asha (Partnerships): Yes, offer two mini-labs: 16:30 and 17:15. Maya, can you create the RSVP and partner-facing agenda?
Maya (Marketing): On it. Will include 'bring your dataset' note and a short setup checklist.
Diego (Eng): One more ops ask: can we have a reserved isolated VLAN for demo rigs to avoid hotel NAT issues? If not, we'll prepare an offline demo bundle. Sam, can you confirm network options with venue?
Sam (Events): Contacting venue now. If VLAN not possible, we'll allocate a local router and pre-seed models.
Logistics Bot: Network options: VLAN request pending. Local router available for pickup at venue. UPS power units x2 reserved for demo tables.
Asha (Partnerships): Great. Final preflight: everyone add any unresolved items as comments in the runbook doc. Dry-run Thu 14:00. Please be in the green room 30m prior. Thanks all!
